newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht hovers at record low level late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht hovers at record low level late.

text.p: The Thai baht remained weak in late trade on Friday, hovering at a record low level, affected by spillover from the Philippine peso crisis, dealers said.
"The baht remained weak in late afternoon trade. There was very strong commercial demand, while dollar selling by exporters was very small," said one dealer at a European bank.
The baht was quoted at around 30.00/30.60 per dollar late in the domestic market from 29.99/30.06 in mid-afternoon trade.
In the offshore market, the baht tumbled to 29.90/30.40 late from 29.50/30.00 in mid-afternoon.
The peso tumbled after the Philippine central bank allowed the currency to move in a wider range against the U.S. dollar.
Dealers said most exporters slowed dollar selling, waiting for the U.S. unit's further strengthening against the baht.
The baht/dollar one-month swap premium was quoted at 24/29 satangs per dollar late in domestic market and 25/35 satangs in the domestic market.
The overnight interbank rate fell to 15-20 percent in late trade from 20-22 in the morning trade on rising liquidity, dealers said.
